subject: Aurora Labs — renewal & uplift kickoff (timeline, owners, QBR slots)
messages:
From: Sophie Patel <sophie.patel@auroralabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Briggs <t.briggs@auroralabs.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2029 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora Labs: renewal & capacity planning

Hi Karthik / Marissa —

Thanks again for last week's demo. We had an exec sync this morning and want to start the formal renewal conversation early so we can lock capacity for next fiscal year and evaluate a 2-year committed uplift. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm pricing for committed throughput tiers (100M tokens/month and 250M tokens/month).
- Proposed term options (12 vs 24 months) and any discount thresholds.
- Timeline to complete procurement and PO.
- Suggested attendees for an internal QBR with execs (we'd like a 30–45m session).

Can you propose a short kickoff and provide a one-pager on the uplift economics and next steps? Procurement (cc'd) may want a separate thread for legal/billing once we have the outline.

Thanks — looking to get this on a tight runway.

Best,
Sophie Patel
Director, Data Platforms 
Aurora Labs
[Attachment: Aurora_CurrentUsage_Summary.csv (CSV, 18 KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Patel <sophie.patel@auroralabs.com>, Tom Briggs <t.briggs@auroralabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Apr 2029 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora Labs: renewal & capacity planning

Sophie — thanks for the clear asks. Looping Marissa and Ben to cover commercial and billing/legal.

High-level proposal and next steps (attached one-pager):

1) Quick kickoff call (30m) — goal: align on baseline usage, target uplift, and decision owners
   - Proposed windows (PST): Apr 5 10:00–10:30, Apr 8 15:00–15:30, Apr 9 09:00–09:30. Please indicate preferred slot.
2) Evaluation of commitment tiers — we’ll share a side-by-side: 12-mo vs 24-mo economics + token pricing per tier
3) QBR agenda (30–45m) — we propose: business outcomes, technical runbook, capacity runway, SLA/escape clauses, procurement checklist
4) Owners:
   - Redwood commercial: Marissa Cole (contracts, discounts)
   - Redwood billing/legal: Ben Carter (billing cadence, invoicing)
   - Redwood technical lead for migration/scale: Rishi Malhotra
   - Aurora exec sponsor: Sophie Patel

Attachments sent: Aurora_Kickoff_1pager.pdf (summary + uplift table), Aurora_MAPlist.xlsx (stakeholder matrix). I also included a draft milestone timeline in the one-pager.

If you want, we can run the QBR as a joint session and then spin up a procurement/legal thread for redlines.

Open items for kickoff: preferred slot, any additional internal stakeholders, and whether Aurora will require an NDA amendment for expanded data ingestion.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Account Executive — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Aurora_Kickoff_1pager.pdf (PDF, 220 KB)]

From: Tom Briggs <t.briggs@auroralabs.com>

Date: Mon, 8 Apr 2029 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora Labs: renewal & capacity planning

Karthik — thanks for the proposal. Apr 9 09:00–09:30 PST works best for our execs (Sophie confirmed). For the kickoff please include a short section on:

- Burst capacity behavior and overage handling (need concrete examples)
- Data retention and audit log export cadence (our compliance team will ask)
- Contract milestones and PO timeline (procurement cc'd)

Procurement: once we see the one-pager and milestone dates we’ll open a PO and share our standard procurement SOW.

Thanks,
Tom Briggs
VP, Engineering — Aurora Labs

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 12 Apr 2029 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora Labs: renewal & capacity planning — billing & PO path

Hi Aurora procurement team — looping in to confirm billing cadence and PO flow. A few practical notes before kickoff on Apr 9:

- We can support monthly or quarterly invoicing for committed tiers. For 24-month commitments we typically offer net-45 with a small early-pay discount.
- Attachment: Billing_Statement_Apr2029.pdf shows current billing cadence and outstanding invoice schedule.
- If you’ll be issuing a PO, please include the deal id DL-84721 and send to billing@redwood.com. We’ll map the PO to the committed tier once countersigned.

Legal redlines can be started after kickoff; Marissa will lead negotiations. If you prefer, we can circulate a redlined SOW template (attached SOW v1).

Looking forward to the call tomorrow.

Best regards,
Ben Carter
Head of Billing Operations — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Billing_Statement_Apr2029.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)]
